Name: Professor Jasper's Unique Children
Author: ceramicmouse
Description:
How to install:

1. Download [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]Unique Children[/url]
2. Put the "Jasper" file in either (or both) the "Natural" or "Adopted" folder in the assets folder of the Unique Children mod.

This mod uses assets from Unique Children, with slight alterations made by me. I have received permission from this mod from both the author of Unique Children as well as the author of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599]Professor Jasper Thomas[/url]
